name: Ami Sushi
notes: 4 photos, all menus. 1.jpg = laminated sushi-bar menu (rolls/nigiri/sashimi), the largest source. 3.jpg is a photo-reference 'Sushi A La Carte' board with no prices, entirely redundant with 1.jpg's classic-roll/nigiri list, so it added no new items. 2.jpg and 4.jpg are two different printed versions of the food menu (appetizers/bento/noodles/rice bowls) with some differing prices for the same items; used 2.jpg (branded Ami Sushi laminated version) as authoritative and skipped 4.jpg's conflicting prices rather than duplicate/contradict. A few Classic Roll hand-roll prices on 1.jpg were obscured by glare and omitted rather than guessed. Soda/tea drinks list omitted as beverages, not dishes.
